limitations: JWT signature/expiry controls validity; logout/restart/replacement login do not universally revoke JWTs.
Client guards do not constitute server token revocation.
Forum playback grants are memory-only and reset on restart.
Startup normalizes basic/mid/top to starter and synchronizes beta access.
Some source initialization errors are swallowed.
No recovery generation marker or create idempotency guarantee: valid same-account stale queued operations may replay after rollback.
Server backup excludes mobile SQLite, AsyncStorage and device queues.
Production infrastructure snapshot consistency, retention, restore behavior, capacity, contents and non-disk assets remain unknown.
